proposed.explanation: Confuses scope with building size; scope is about deliverables and services, not building dimensions. Confuses scope with budget; scope defines what services are included, not how much the construction costs. Confuses scope with location; scope defines deliverables and services, not where the building is built. Scope is the defined set of deliverables and services—project phases, deliverables per phase, included and excluded services, and client responsibilities. Scope is what the architect will deliver and provide, not the building size, cost, or location.
